examples.text: It was first blood to the Black Cats in the ding-dong clash when Bardsley, a right-footer playing on the left, collected the ball from just inside his own half and sped up to the edge of the area before launching an effort which appeared to confuse Petr Cech in goal.

glosses: One of several sounds that might be made by a bell.

examples.text: Oh, no, man, I haven't got the time time / Too busy sucking on a ding-dong / She's busy sucking on my ding-dong

glosses: A fight, an argument; a set-to.
An attachment to a clock by which the quarter hours are struck upon bells of different tones.
To ring with two tones, like a bell swinging back and forth.
Onomatopée évoquant le son de cloche.
